Regression metrics.

Computes regression metrics from numeric actual and predicted columns.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | regression, metrics, mse, rmse, mae, r2 |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Metrics** | Dataset | No | 1 | Metric/value table |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actual_col | `actual_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric actual value column. Required. |
| predicted_col | `predicted_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric predicted value column. Required. |
| metrics | `metrics` | Text | `mse,rmse,mae,r2` |   | The run | Comma-separated: mse, rmse, mae, r2, count. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
